title: Oil Is Again Flowing Out of Hormuz
gist: Crude flows out of the Strait of Hormuz have nearly doubled to about 13.5 million b/d under U.S. naval escorts and a blockade that has cut Iranian exports almost to zero, but refined product flows remain roughly 3 million b/d short. Combined with Ukrainian strikes on Russian refineries and Chinese export bans, diesel prices stay near records for possibly another year, while costly escorts, twentyfold freight rates and a cornered Iran make the recovery fragile.
